# scamp_router (Resource)

Manages a router in SCAMP. Routers provide internet access for attached networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_router" "main" {
  name = "main-router"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the router.
- `name` (String) Name of the router (1-64 characters). Auto-generated if not provided.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags to assign to the router as key-value pairs.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the router was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the router.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Public IPv4 address assigned to the router.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6 address assigned to the router.
- `status` (String) Current status of the router (provision_queued, active, etc.).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_router.main 143465a7-1b8e-4b0e-9c1f-2f6a7d4c9e11
```
